description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing SSL/TLS certificates, keys, certificate stores, and secure socket ports within the Thunder::Crypto namespace. It includes class declarations for Certificate, Key, CertificateStore, and SecureSocketPort, along with nested Handler class for socket operations.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate, providing methods to access issuer, subject, validity period, and hostname validation.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents an encryption key, supporting initialization from a key structure or file.

classes.name: CertificateStore
classes.description: Manages a store of certificates, allowing addition and retrieval of default store.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Provides an interface for secure socket communication, including certificate management, validation, and data transmission.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::IValidate
classes.description: Interface for custom validation of certificates during SSL/TLS handshake.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Internal class managing socket connection states, SSL context, and data transfer.

classes.name: SecureSocketServerType
classes.description: Template class for server-side SSL socket configuration with certificate and key.

methods.name: Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start time of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidTill
methods.description: Returns the end time of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate's hostname matches the expected hostname.

methods.name: CertificateStore::Add
methods.description: Adds a certificate to the store.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
methods.description: Sets the certificate and key for the secure socket port.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the secure socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the secure socket.
